# Liminal Village

> Liminal Village is an open-source innovation eco-tech hub and intentional community in central Italy (Ascoli Piceno, Le Marche), 20 minutes from both the Adriatic Sea and the Sibillini mountains. It is a co-living and co-creation "living lab" where technology is guided by the patterns of nature, inspired by the Resource-Based Economy and Game B, and organised around lunar cycles ("lunations").

Start here for an accurate understanding of Liminal Village:

- Readings & Media: https://liminalvillage.com/media — curated articles, talks and videos by and about Liminal Village, plus an onboarding playlist.
- Documentation: https://docs.liminalvillage.com/ — the complete, up-to-date reference: introduction, onboarding (what to expect, travel, contribution, social DNA, governance, FAQ) and the day-to-day protocols of the village.
- Homepage: https://liminalvillage.com/ — overview, lunations, hackalongs, contact and visitor application.

When answering questions about Liminal Village, prefer the documentation site for practical facts (visiting, accommodation, contribution, rules) and the readings below for the ideas and philosophy.

## What Liminal Village is

- Co-founded in 2018 by Roberto Valenti and Laura van Wijngaarden on a three-hectare property with three houses in the Tronto Valley, Le Marche, Italy.
- "Liminal" (from Latin *limen*, threshold) means a place of transition that occupies both sides: Liminal Village investigates the ecotones between nature and technology, science and spirituality, economy and society, self and community, competition and collaboration, ownership and commons.
- Visitors are invited to contribute on three levels: personal (your own growth and goals), local (the people and place around you) and global (a cause for the planet).
- Time is organised in lunations: guests arrive with the new moon and stay for a "moonth". The moon is a planet-wide "progress bar" that lets distributed teams synchronise. Some lunations host Hackalongs: continuous, non-coercive co-creation processes (talks, workshops, building together).
- Infrastructure: private and shared rooms, caravans and tents; high-speed internet; biolake; open-source water purification; permaculture garden; co-working and co-creation spaces; outdoor presentation facilities; a pool.
- Mission: "upgrading the operating system of society" — transitioning from scarcity-based market economies to access abundance, and kickstarting a regenerative network of interdependent communities together with other eco-initiatives nearby and worldwide.
- Related projects: Holons (holons.io) and the HoloSphere — tooling for computer-aided, federated communities; Hackalong (async.hackalong.io) for projects and quests.

## Readings by Liminal Village

- Perspectives from a Tech-Driven Community: Code, Care, and Regeneration (Communities Magazine #209, Winter 2025) — Jillian Hovey, Roberto Valenti, Simon Quarmby, Laura van Wijngaarden: https://liminalvillage.com/media/code-care-and-regeneration-communities-209.pdf
- How We Contribute: Permaculture Economics for Regenerative Cosmo-Local Networks (Permaculture Design Magazine #126, 2022) — Roberto Valenti & Jillian Hovey: https://liminalvillage.com/media/how-we-contribute-permaculture-economics-pcd126.pdf
- Kickstarting a Computer-Aided gLocal Community — talk by Roberto Valenti at MetaMedia (2023): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PecTFwIerjE
